2	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op input type must be 64/32/16 bitwidth, but got 8
3	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op expects RZ or RP rounding mode when result type is e8m0, but got #nvvm.fp_rnd_mode<rn>
4	parse	custom op 'nvgpu.truncf' 'nvgpu.truncf' op attribute 'sat' failed to satisfy constraint: Describes the saturation mode whose value is one of {none, satfinite}
5	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op expects RN rounding mode, but got #nvvm.fp_rnd_mode<rz>

7	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op RS (stochastic) rounding is only supported for f32->f16/bf16, got 'f32' -> 'f8E4M3FN'
8	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op random_bits operand is required with RS rounding
9	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op expects RN rounding mode, but got #nvvm.fp_rnd_mode<rp>
10	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op random_bits can only be used with RS rounding mode
11	verify	'nvgpu.truncf' op input and output shapes must match, got 'vector<16xf32>' and 'vector<8xf8E4M3FN>'
